verdict.rationale: llamafile exposes a local HTTP server with an API and Web UI (docs-9, docs-5), which is technically the kind of backend a coding agent could point at, but the evidence pack never documents an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, tool/function-calling support, or any concrete example of a coding agent (e.g. Aider, Continue) using llamafile as its backend. Missing for 10: explicit API-compatibility spec (OpenAI-style endpoints), documented agent/framework integration guides, and community/hands-on confirmation of coding-agent usage.
